label: Too expensive
description: The subscription cost is too high for the user's budget

label: Not using the service enough
description: User feels they don't use the service frequently enough to justify the cost

label: Missing features I need
description: User needs functionality that is not currently available

label: Technical issues
description: User experienced bugs, performance problems, or other technical difficulties

label: Switching to another service
description: User is moving to a competitor or alternative solution

label: Taking a temporary break
description: User plans to pause usage temporarily and may return later

label: Poor customer support
description: User had negative experiences with customer service

label: Quality of output/service
description: User is unsatisfied with the quality of generated content or service

label: Other
description: User has a different reason not listed above
